description_en: Configures whether to enable the certificate feature for a site and updates certificate information
description_zh: 用于设置某站点下是否启用证书功能及更新证书信息
name: SetCertificate

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The certificate name. This parameter is required when Type is set to upload
parameters.help_zh: 证书名称，type为upload类型时需要输入该参数
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The cloud certificate ID. This parameter is required when Type is set to cas
parameters.help_zh: 云证书Id，type为cas的情况下需要输入该参数
parameters.name: cas_id

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. Valid values:

cas: a certificate from SSL Certificates Service.

upload: a custom uploaded certificate.

keyless: a keyless certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型。

cas：证书中心证书

upload：自定义上传证书

keyless：keyless证书
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The certificate content. This parameter is required when Type is set to upload
parameters.help_zh: 证书内容，type为upload类型时需要输入该参数
parameters.name: certificate

parameters.help_en: The certificate private key. This parameter is required when Type is set to upload
parameters.help_zh: 证书私钥，type为upload类型时需要输入该参数
parameters.name: private_key

parameters.help_en:
The region. This parameter is required when Type is set to cas. Valid values:

Alibaba Cloud China Website accounts: cn-hangzhou.

Alibaba Cloud International Website accounts: ap-southeast-1
parameters.help_zh:
地域，type为cas的情况下需要输入该参数。

中国站账号传参数值：cn-hangzhou

国际站账号传参数值：ap-southeast-1
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The certificate ID. Free certificates created by calling the ApplyCertificate operation are not supported. Certificate IDs of the cas and upload types are supported
parameters.help_zh: 证书Id，不支持 free 类型（通过接口ApplyCertificate创建）的证书 Id，可以支持 cas 和 upload 类型的证书 Id
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The keyless server ID. This parameter takes effect only when Type is set to keyless
parameters.name: key_server_id
